Features of Temp/Humidity LHU-113 Chamber
To ensure a controlled environment, the LHU-113 model also includes an inner glass door, allowing door openings without disrupting the conditions in the chamber. A one-inch diameter cable port in the left side allows wires and cables to be run to your samples. 
 Programmable controller with nine steps and up to 99 loops 
 Timer function for automatic start and stop 
 Inner glass door 
 One-inch cable port with cap on left wall 
 Two adjustable shelves 
 Internal water tank for flexibility in locating unit 
 Three levels of overheat protection 
 Main power circuit breaker
